speaker: Daniel
text: Nobody had ever seen the moon's far side before the Soviet Union launched the Luna 3 probe in 1959. It was the first-ever mission to photograph the far side. The United States Apollo 8 mission sent three astronauts around the moon in 1968, the first time humans saw the moon's far side with their own eyes. Now China sent the first-ever probe to soft-land and rove on the far side, which has deepened our understanding of the moon, the earth, and the universe.
